questions.passage:
[주어진 글] In 2012, scientists met at the University of Cambridge to talk about consciousness in humans and animals.

(A) For example, African grey parrots have shown evidence of consciousness that is almost as advanced as that of humans. Even octopuses have the brain structures needed for subjective experiences.
(B) Consciousness means having subjective experiences or awareness. The scientists found that animals have emotions and can have consciousness like humans.
(C) Drugs that affect human consciousness also affect some animals in similar ways. So, the scientists concluded that consciousness is not just for humans. Animals can have it too.
questions.stem: 주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것을 고르시오.

det.ref: [해석] [주어진 글] 의식 논의 → (B) 의식 정의 + 동물 감정 → (A) 예시(앵무새, 문어) → (C) 약물 + 결론.
det.correct:
(B)-(A)-(C) 순서 ✅
(B) 의식 정의(Consciousness means...) → 주어진 글의 consciousness 정의
(A) 예시(For example...) → 정의 후 구체적 예시
(C) 추가 근거 + 결론(So, concluded) → 마무리
det.tip: 🔑 순서 전략: consciousness → (B)정의 → (A)For example = 예시 → (C)So = 결론.

questions.passage: Octopuses' use of tools can be found in their love of toys and puzzles, too. ① They are curious about new objects, and do not like getting bored. ② That is why aquariums try to come up with ideas to keep their octopuses busy. ③ Some aquariums hide food inside a big doll and let the octopus break up the toy to get the food. ④ Octopuses are also known for their short lifespan, living only one to two years on average. ⑤ Others offer plastic building blocks for their octopuses to play with.
questions.stem: 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장을 고르시오.

det.ref: [해석] 주제: 장난감/퍼즐 사랑. ④는 '짧은 수명(1~2년)'으로 주제와 무관.
det.correct:
① 새 물체 호기심: 관련 ✅
② 수족관 노력: 관련 ✅
③ 인형 속 음식: 관련 ✅
④ 짧은 수명: 무관 ❌
⑤ 블록 제공: 관련 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 무관 문장: 중심 소재(장난감/호기심)와 다른 소재(수명)가 갑자기 등장하면 무관!

questions.passage: A few octopuses were found to collect coconut shells. They cleaned the shells with bursts of water, carried them to a new location, and piled them as a shelter. Traveling with the shells under their bodies forced them to walk slowly along the sea floor. This made the octopuses more exposed to predators. But it seems that they were willing to take that risk for greater future protection. The scientists who discovered the behavior argue that this is clear evidence of octopuses using tools.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 they가 과학자들(The scientists)을 가리키면 T, 아니면 F를 선택하시오.

det.ref: [원문] they were willing to take that risk for greater future protection. [해석] they = 문어들(octopuses). 포식자 노출 위험을 감수하는 주체는 문어.
det.correct:
T (과학자들): 위험 감수 주체가 과학자 → 문맥 부적절 ❌
F (문어들): they = octopuses → 올바른 해석 ✅
det.tip: 🔑 대명사 선행사: 바로 앞 문장의 주어 확인 → the octopuses → they = octopuses.

questions.passage:
During the past few decades, scientists have begun to find more and more similarities between octopuses and humans. One of the most interesting ones is intelligence. The best evidence is their ability to camouflage themselves. Another sign is their use of tools. In the wild, they use stones to create walls to protect the entrances to their homes.

[요약문] Scientists have discovered that octopuses show signs of (A) _______ through their camouflage ability and their use of (B) _______.

<보기> intelligence / tools / poison / color / horror
questions.stem: 빈칸 (A)와 (B)에 들어갈 말을 <보기>에서 골라 쓰시오. (예: (A) ___, (B) ___)

det.ref: [해석] 문어는 위장 능력과 도구 사용을 통해 지능의 징후를 보인다. (A)=intelligence, (B)=tools.
det.correct:
(A) intelligence: 글의 핵심 주제 ✅
(B) tools: 두 번째 증거 ✅
poison/color/horror: 부적절 ❌
det.tip: 🔑 요약문 완성: 핵심 키워드 대입. intelligence의 증거 = camouflage + tools.
